Message.Name: System Time Message
Message.Description: This is the message format that will be used to disseminate the “seconds” part of the timestamp that is applicable to all messages that are sent in the current second.

Field.Name: Seconds
Field.Description: Seconds part of the time that applies to all messages that gets disseminated until this message gets sent again.

Message.Name: Symbol Definition Message
Message.Description: This is the message format that will be used to disseminate all Synthetic Future symbol definitions for the current session.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Time at which this product is added/updated on MIAX system today.

Field.Name: Synthetic Future Symbol
Field.Description: Synthetic Future Symbol: The first 3 characters are the base symbol, followed by a single character expiration month code and a single digit expiration year code.

Field.Name: Settlement Date
Field.Description: Settlement date of the Option associated with the Synthetic Future in YYYYMMDD format

Field.Name: Symbol Status
Field.Description: Indicates if this Synthetic Future symbol is going to get price updates on MIAX in the current session

Message.Name: Index Value Message
Message.Description: This is the message format that will be used to disseminate current index value. The index value may be the index cash value or the index settlement value, as identified by the Index Symbol.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Time at which this index value was calculated.

Message.Name: Synthetic Future Value Message
Message.Description: This is the message format that will be used to disseminate current Synthetic Future values. The specific Synthetic Future value is identified by the Synthetic Future Symbol.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Time at which this Synthetic Future value was calculated.
